root_cause: The Netlify backend production-truth step passed routes-ok as steps.routes.outcome == 'success'. For delivery that changes only Netlify functions the browser route step is skipped, its outcome is 'skipped', so routes-ok became false and verify-production-release returned PRODUCTION_RED/production_route_regression although the exact deploy was ready and healthy. Observed on main c9e4823 and 8572034.
prevention: The backend step now treats routes as satisfied when browser verification is not required (browser_required != 'true') and otherwise still requires the routes step to succeed, matching the non-deployment step.

evidence.runtime_status: unverified until the Production Release Readback of the next backend-only merge to main is green

limitations: Only the routes-ok expression changes; deploy identity, readiness and portal proof checks are unchanged
Runtime effect is proven only by the next backend-only merge
